About Us (Ensono)

Ensono is an expert technology adviser and managed service provider. As a relentless ally, we accelerate clients’ digital transformation to achieve business outcomes that stand to last. Our dedicated team helps organizations optimize today’s systems across any hybrid environment with services such as consulting, mainframe and application modernization, public cloud migration and cloud-native development. With certified experts in AWS, Azure and Google Cloud and recognized as Microsoft Datacenter Transformation Partner of the Year, Ensono has over 3500+ associates globally and is headquartered in greater Chicago.

We care about your success, offering comprehensive strategic and managed services for mission-critical applications. Our Advisory and Consulting services can help upfront with an application strategy or find the right places for your applications – whether it’s public, multi or hybrid cloud, or mainframe. And because we span across all mission-critical platforms, we can meet you wherever you are in your digital transformation journey, with 24/7 support when you need it. We are your relentless ally, flexing with you when challenges emerge so you don’t feel stuck in place. With cross-platform certifications and decades of experience, our technology experts have become an extension of your team so you’re continuously innovating – doing more with less while remaining secure. And that’s just the beginning.

 

Job Description: Senior Azure Cloud Consultant

Job Summary

Ensono’s Public Cloud Consulting practice is expanding to support enterprise-scale cloud transformation, modernization, and AI-driven initiatives. We are seeking a Senior Azure Cloud Consultant to lead the design and delivery of secure, scalable, cost-efficient, and automated cloud platforms on Microsoft Azure.

You will act as a trusted advisor and technical leader, driving end-to-end engagements—from strategy and architecture through implementation and optimization—across migration, modernization, platform engineering, and AI adoption.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead customer engagements across the full consulting lifecycle: discovery, architecture, design, implementation, and optimization
  • Drive Azure modernization strategies (rehost → refactor → rearchitect → rebuild)
  • Architect and implement enterprise landing zones aligned with Azure CAF & Well-Architected Framework
  • Deliver platform engineering solutions (self-service platforms, golden paths, reusable modules)
  • Run architecture/design workshops and produce high-quality HLD/LLD documentation
  • Provide technical leadership and escalation support across delivery teams
  • Embed security, compliance, and governance (DevSecOps) into all solutions
  • Champion automation-first approach using IaC and CI/CD pipelines
  • Mentor consultants and contribute to practice development, accelerators, and standards
  • Support pre-sales, solutioning, and client advisory engagements

 

Role Positioning (Senior Level Expectations)

  • Acts as go-to technical authority
  • Balances architecture + hands-on delivery
  • Drives standards, accelerators, and innovation
  • Influences client strategy and long-term cloud adoption roadmap

Core Technical Capabilities

Azure Architecture & Core Services

  • Enterprise-scale Azure design (Landing Zones, Management Groups, Policy)
  • Advanced networking (Hub-Spoke, Azure Firewall, Private Link, ExpressRoute)
  • Identity (Entra ID, Hybrid Identity, Conditional Access, Zero Trust)

Modernization & Cloud-Native

  • PaaS-first and cloud-native architectures (App Services, Functions, AKS)
  • Microservices, event-driven and API-first design patterns
  • Containerization (Docker) and orchestration (AKS)

Infrastructure as Code & Automation

  • Terraform (preferred), Bicep/ARM
  • CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions)
  • GitOps practices and environment standardization
  • Integration of GenAI (Azure OpenAI), Copilot, and AI-driven automation

FinOps & Cost Optimization

  • Cost governance, budgeting, tagging strategies
  • Right-sizing and optimization
  • Business value articulation and ROI focus

 

DevOps & Platform Engineering

  • Strong DevOps mindset with emphasis on:
    • CI/CD maturity and automation-first culture
    • Shift-left testing, security, and compliance
    • Deployment strategies (blue/green, canary, rolling)
  • Experience building developer platforms / internal developer portals
  • Integration with tools like GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Terraform Cloud

 

Consulting & Leadership Skills

  • Strong client-facing consulting experience
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Executive-level communication and presentation skills
  • Proven ability to lead workshops and influence stakeholders
  • Mentoring and team leadership capabilities

 

Experience Requirements

  • 12+ years in IT with 8+ years in Azure cloud consulting/delivery
  • Bachelor of Engineering (or equivalent) from a reputed university; Master’s degree preferred.
  • Proven experience delivering:
    • Large-scale Azure migrations and modernization
    • Enterprise cloud platforms (Landing Zones)
    • DevOps and automation solutions
  • Hands-on experience in design, build, and troubleshooting
  • Experience working in global delivery models and enterprise environments

 

Nice to Have

  • Azure certifications (Expert level – Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer)
  • Experience with multi-cloud (AWS/GCP)
  • Exposure to platform engineering frameworks (Backstage, IDP)

Knowledge of industry compliance (ISO, GDPR, etc.)
